notes.title: Update 0.7.9.3
notes.content: [p]We're super excited to introduce our first Balance Update for y'all today. This update will shake up the overall strategy for both regular games and competitive matches in the PCL. Accompanying those balance adjustments are a handful of bug fixes and other improvements. For a condensed list of patch notes, check the bottom of this announcement. [/p][p][/p][h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1][p]Our goal with the following balance adjustments are not to make the game "more balanced". Instead, we are aiming to refresh the meta by shifting the balance, creating new and refreshing strategies for players. Starting on January 1st, there will be a new Balance Update every 3 months to match each new POLYGON Competitive League season. Each Balance Update, we will be nerfing some of the stronger guns, and buffing some of the weaker guns to create a new meta. [/p][p][/p][h3]G36C[/h3][p]Our goal is to completely remove the G36C from the competitive meta. Its been at the top of the food chain for way too long, though we're sure it'll eventually find its way back to the top in a future meta. This however, is not that time.[/p][p](-) Reduced damage from 25 -> 24[/p][p](-) Reduced rate of fire from 750 -> 725[/p][p](-) Reduced bullet velocity by 10%[/p][p](-) Reduced mobility from 107 -> 105[/p][p][/p][h3]AK12[/h3][p]While the AK12 wasn't overpowered, we wanted to knock it down a bit to give way for new guns in the meta. It's power is still within the same range as some of the other 'balanced' guns like the M16A4 and AK74M[/p][p](-) Decreased rate of fire from 650 -> 630[/p][p](-) Decreased mobility from 105 -> 100[/p][p][/p][h3]ASVAL[/h3][p]We want the ASVAL to fit a niche role as a fast paced assassin like weapon. Quick, silent, and finally deadly. We believe this buff, while not making it super strong in all maps, will finally give the ASVAL a place in the meta.[/p][p](+) Increased damage from 24 -> 25[/p][p](+) Reduced tactical reload speed from 2.85 -> 2.73[/p][p](+) Reduced empty reload speed from 3.35 -> 3.07[/p][p](+) Increased magazine capacity from 20 -> 25[/p][p](+) Increased mobility from 104 -> 107[/p][p][/p][h3]AK47[/h3][p]We're giving the AK47 a big damage boost, especially for headshots. Additionally, there's some extra recoil to compensate, and some extra movement speed. The AK47 is finally good again, and especially rewarding for high skill players.[/p][p](+) Increased damage from 31 -> 32[/p][p](-) Increased recoil from 25 -> 28[/p][p](+) Increased mobility from 100 -> 105[/p][p](+) Increased headshot multiplier from 2 -> 2.2[/p][p](+) Increased rate of fire from 600 -> 615[/p][p][/p][h3]SCAR-H[/h3][p]The goal with the Scar is to nudge it in the direction of meta. We want to increase its power at high level play, and make it better at range.[/p][p](+) Increased headshot multiplier from 2 -> 2.25[/p][p](+) Increased bullet velocity multiplier from 1 -> 1.05[/p][p](-) Increased recoil from 27 -> 30[/p][p][/p][h3]M24[/h3][p]To go along with the cycle animation fix from last patch, we wanted to make the M24 feel a bit cooler to play. With this one change, headshot collaterals will finally kill. This mostly guarantees a kill any time you hit a headshot with the M24. Time to get clips! [/p][p](+) Increased headshot multiplier from 2 -> 2.55[/p][p][/p][h3]Holographic Sight[/h3][p]Our goal is to provide a proper middle ground between scopes like the ACOG and small sights like the Red Dot. The Holographic Sight will now give a noticeable amount of magnification, without being a long range scope. Keep in mind, sights in POLYGON don't use a realistic magnification, rather they change the FOV of the camera.[/p][p](+) Increased the FOV magnification of the Holographic sight from 80 to 70[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Cargo Balance Adjustments[/h1][p]Cargo has been a staple in the POLYGON Competitive League since the beginning. But, it hasn't been the most balanced battleground. With these small changes, we hope to make the map a little more balanced for both sides, by reducing the amount of angles in certain powerful positions. While this more than likely won't "fix" the balance of the map, it should be a step in the right direction. Let us know what you think![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/62524087e147ceadf1e2608162d60786fb5808c2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/30ca3c4e6d90a7b0dadfd2876d77139558865bfe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]POLYGON Competitive League Leaderboards[/h1][p]Ever wanted to play against the top rated players in a competitive environment? Join the PCL and queue up for ranked! We now have the PCL Ranked Leaderboard in the main menu to flex your ranking on to the entire POLYGON Community. The next PCL season will begin on October 1st, it will feature new rewards (skins, patches, and more) as well as a revamped ranking system. Join the POLYGON Competitive League![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/7813c431635f924bd254853968cb720b37f92e6f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, the Pro League standings are now displayed in the main menu![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/6d794e9dc9c3130d21b71d12f9851a1f77322d0d.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][url="https://discord.gg/QEdusZfyQH "]JOIN THE POLYGON COMPETITIVE LEAGUE![/url][/h1][p][/p][p][/p][h2]New[/h2][list][*][p]  Added the current health number to the health bar[/p][/*][*][p]  Added the POLYGON Competitive League leaderboard to the main menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]  Decreased the amount of time you are blocked from new actions, like shooting and sprinting, after throwing a grenade[/p][/*][*][p]  Adjusted the M16A4 shoot audio to be a little deeper[/p][/*][*][p]  Lower Arm hits now deal full damage rather than 93%[/p][/*][*][p]  Increased the damage grace period after death from 1 second to 1.5, you should see fewer "no-regs" after death. We'll be monitoring the effect of this change.[/p][/*][*][p]  Slightly increased opacity of the borders [/p][/*][*][p]  Stamina no longer decreases when jumping at slow speeds[/p][/*][*][p]  Cargo balance adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]  Significantly improved the hit registration of grenades[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]  Fixed the wall climbing exploit[/p][/*][*][p]  Fixed an issue where changing player skins was not working properly[/p][/*][*][p]  Fixed some incorrect collisions on Storage[/p][/*][*][p]  Further fixed the rechambering cancel bug on M24[/p][/*][*][p]  Fixed a bug that caused reload animations on pistols to cancel[/p][/*][*][p]  Fixed more bugs regarding to changing teams and re-enabled the Change Team button[/p][/*][*][p]  Fixed the display name of the Pirate patch[/p][/*][*][p]  Fixed a bug that caused a single bullet to sometimes hit a player twice (this was the cause of the M24 one shot body issue)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balance[/h2][list][*][p]  Nerfed the G36C, worse time to kill and worse at range[/p][/*][*][p]  Nerfed AK12, slightly worse time to kill, slower movement[/p][/*][*][p]  Buffed the ASVal, better time to kill and faster pace of play[/p][/*][*][p]  Buffed the AK47, more damage overall and faster movement[/p][/*][*][p]  Buffed the ScarH, more rewarding headshots and better at range[/p][/*][*][p]  Buffed the M24, far more damage on headshots to allow collateral kills[/p][/*][*][p]  Increased the FOV magnification of the Holographic sight from 80 to 70[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]What's Next?[/h1][p]Our next update will take a bit longer to come out than the last few. We don't want to give out all of our plans just yet, but we expect 0.7.10 to take us about 1 month. It will feature some cool map adjustments, including Crash Site King of the Hill. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7.5 | THE ART OF WAR
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We are excited to present [b]Update 0.7.5[/b], featuring new functions, improvements, and fixes to enhance your gaming experience.
We also have [b]important news[/b] about the future of Polygon.
Let's start with the changes in this update:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]BATTLE PASS SEASON 4[/h2]

Welcome to the [b]new Battle Pass season - The Art of War[/b].
This new season includes new weapon skins, wristwatches, VIP status, and Crowns.
Additionally, it introduces brand new cosmetic content for Polygon, including [b]character skins[/b], [b]patches[/b], and weapon [b]charms[/b].
This Battle Pass will be [b]the most content-rich in the game's history[/b].
Don't miss the chance to express your uniqueness on the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/d98b6c7308825640374605220b8db5ea9af775d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0f5418fc900c782c21414f5af60c08a1031f442e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/64ef85baa6d2e5e17a0eb9d568226f95d18f40be.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]AS "VAL"[/h2]

The game has been updated with a new assault rifle - [b]AS "VAL"[/b].
This perfect combination of high rate of fire, mobility, and stealth will make your enemies nervous whenever you appear.
With the "VAL," you can effectively and silently eliminate targets, instilling fear and panic among opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/6422c29d79ef6a3a9210a1cee3b18848e0d6663f.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]NIGHT CRASH SITE[/h2]

The Crash Site map has received a night version.
[b]Prepare your flashlights![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/c856c3fa65404b7c79b1e8d952cf75f18de59ee9.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]STYLE[/h2]

New cosmetic items, including [b]character skins[/b], [b]patches[/b] and weapon [b]charms[/b] have been added to the game.
Character skins affect only clothing and do not impact external equipment (helmet, plate carrier), allowing you to always identify your enemies by their appearance.
You can obtain new style items in the new Battle Pass season and purchase them through the in-game store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/b9f42bf82a6c8bb82711965267acbeda182cecc8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/1232a6f08db38dc5bc7db8a27b3d1430a773b10e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/c130477f66e21225ede91cae8e92f83e26d5edd7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/12468f800d4ec84f86caf38d9136d0bdb9365f39.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]CROWN PURCHASE DISCOUNT[/h2]

For a [b]limited time[/b], you can get a discount of [b]up to 35%[/b] on Crown purchases.
Don't miss the chance to get the new Battle Pass at a great discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/572255dcdd7e220dfe8a310e7002cdd7284f7a0a.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]OTHER CHANGES:[/h3]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]NEW[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a new weapon module - "Angled Grip";
[*] Added tactical reloading. Now, during incomplete reloading, the round in the chamber will be preserved, allowing you to make an additional shot (e.g., 30 -> 31);
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[list]
[*] Optimized storm performance on the "Sandstorm" map;
[*] Some shaders in the game have been optimized;
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]NOW FOR IMPORTANT NEWS:[/h1]

Today, I want to share important news about the future of Polygon.
This announcement requires an honest conversation because big changes are coming, and I want to be transparent with you.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Reasons for the changes:[/h3]

[b]Hi, guys,[/b]
My name is Nick, and I am the main creator and lead developer of the game.
When I started developing Polygon, I was very inexperienced in game development, especially in first-person shooters.
But I had a dream: I always wanted to create a truly large-scale shooter.
However, I knew that first, we needed a stable foundation for the game, so I focused only on infantry battles.
But the dream never went away.

Update 0.7 finally gave the game the necessary foundation, and about a year ago, I began looking towards my initial goal.
To fully realize my goal, I needed certain tools, and the release of Unreal Engine 5 provided the necessary technologies for this.

Few people know that I am a big fan of Battlefield 3/4.
The existing "Metro" map proves this, as it is a partial copy of the original version.
Initially, Polygon was planned as an analog for Battlefield.
This was supposed to include large-scale maps with many players, military equipment, destructibility, and other elements characteristic of the Battlefield series.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/d431d7aa2a3a340f07581e1ad9d8308ac58f794d.png[/img]

So, I made a serious decision to start a new path, [b]a new story.[/b]
For some time now, I have been developing something more global than the current Polygon.
I think we can call it [b]Polygon 2[/b] (PG2).
And yes, it will be a [b]new game[/b] because I don't want to break the gaming experience of players in the current Polygon.
Of course, there are those who do not share my vision and may not want such colossal changes.
Therefore, the current Polygon will maintain its position of close-range infantry battles.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]What will change?[/h3]

[b]Everything.[/b]

Classes will be added to the game: [b]Assault, Support, Engineer, and Scout.[/b]
Each class will have its unique feature, significantly impacting gameplay.
This will also make the game more team-oriented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/8c4c92fa73179c0fd3e1fb498ee3d5b15b18ffe1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/ef44275682233b6516b1ebade455fec6ee54e56c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/9aac16b4c970582d4c9185e0b04adce63dda4100.jpg[/img]

Military equipment will appear in the game, from ATVs to [b]tanks and combat helicopters[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/87466a25f90f95b1f7c2e0a6b9cb9a6d4dda0859.jpg[/img]

You will be able to influence the game world with a [b]destruction system[/b]: a building will collapse like a house of cards after C4 detonation, and fallen trees will serve as defense against the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/965d212315e1601a980b7a17dc37a43bd81e27eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/be5ec5f0c4191b6fe7258a6a6546e6fbc5dbc7ce.png[/img]

We are creating [b]completely new maps[/b] for PG2.
Current maps will [b]NOT[/b] be transferred to PG2 because they simply do not fit the new requirements.

We could list all the changes for a long time, but we'll leave that for future announcements.

Unfortunately, at this time, the gameplay is in such a state that I cannot show it.
But I can demonstrate some of the changes that PG2 will receive.

We decided to start development by recreating one of the most popular maps.
We strive to achieve maximum accuracy, maintaining [b]95%[/b] of the original scales and the location of all objects.
The goal is to show the intention to move in a direction that will be [b]familiar and understandable to every player[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/13b7a21ec7d801bdf82a1322da84263a98a44579.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/a96266d1910f64224ab9d28c365dd14d13d83253.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/3d80cbbb9320e48fd5cf64669b9df1300996f06e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/e1637cfa23e4e2e7e5100666c1279e5100f0808c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/249d946e1b2fc15559903b8c39ef0ebbc0707f0d.png[/img]

[i]I will reiterate that this is a super early version of development.[/i]
[i]The map still lacks numerous objects, visual effects, and other elements.[/i]

[b]Now let's talk a little about the style of PG2.[/b]
As you may have noticed, the graphics in PG2 will become more realistic, and at the same time, the game will receive a new feature - [b]pixelation[/b].
This will preserve the game's stylization while adding many missing details that we would like to see in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/610b0e3ec17082e98e2415b69112bb83cfdaea2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/14c38a22de4ea738b157580258223d3bfc43c8e3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/1fbac9dd2e38c455cae9b943f444647f4b62506f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/36082b8014a43043b77afebbc6c7cbe5aeeeae82.jpg[/img]

[b]PG2 will receive an arsenal update.[/b]
Numerous types of assault and sniper rifles, SMGs, and LMGs are in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/2db67611567b3b0f2d6d6e149268a17fd7e88232.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0e878c1f5776a9e4f7e79f5981f39a28c89307fd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/512d4cbd0b42d7e786b35dd20428bb398848cdec.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/b3f24bc6399faf9937e56dcf382e5defe18a5e75.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/96112b75f6d09e927bba85af67904c80077b2d06.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/9044e99f0c91357182511dbdae222ceedc1bfa0a.jpg[/img]

Such items as [b]C4, claymores, smoke grenades[/b], and other tactical tools will also be added.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 0.7 | OPERATION: SCARLET STORM
notes.content:
[h3]The moment has come.[/h3]
Finally, we are ready to present you a grand update - 0.7.
At the moment, this is the [b]largest update[/b] in the history of the game.
We have invested all our efforts, passion and talent to bring you incredible innovations.
Get ready for an explosive experience that will change your idea of battles.

The weapon in your hands has become even more powerful and effective. 
And the [b]new progression system[/b] will allow you to change the characteristics of your weapons that meet your unique style of play and become a real warrior, ready for any challenges.
The arsenal of the game has received an update in the form of a new [b]AK308[/b] assault rifle and a [b]Kriss Vector[/b] submachine gun.

Explore locations enlivened by a unique atmosphere.
The [b]new Cargo map[/b] will give you an incredible new gameplay in 5 vs 5 battles.

We have also fixed a number of bugs and improved the performance of the game so that you can fully immerse yourself in its world without obstacles. 

Thanks to all our dedicated players who have supported us along the way. 
Your passion and faith in our project inspire us to strive to improve the game!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]NEW CHARACTER[/h1]

In this update, we have completely updated the character model. 
Now the character has significantly more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/415c9cabd029277a641c5a251c1229addda8b0cd.png[/img]

We also completely redesigned the character's skeleton and significantly increased the quality of most animations. 
Let's just take a look at some updated weapon handling animations.

[previewyoutube=C7QfUN-0Ya0;full][/previewyoutube]
All other animations have also been completely redesigned. You can look at it in the game.

Also, of course, we have updated the models of each element of the character's equipment. 
Now it's also much more detailed than before.
Take a look at the fully equipped character in the game: 

[previewyoutube=fSxf2uXBRII;full][/previewyoutube]
Now finally the character's equipment has a different color for each team. 
This will allow you to better distinguish allies from enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/e07e4963243a5c5a4640c041b95db6c5d3b9a29f.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]NEW WEAPON PROGRESSION SYSTEM[/h1]

In this update, the weapon progression system has been completely redesigned. 
Here's how it works:

Each weapon now has a separate level.
Experience (XP) gained for kills, head shots, as well as assistance in killing, will also increase the XP of the weapon used.
With XP, you'll be able to explore new modules for each weapon.

Almost all modules affect the characteristics of the gun. 
Modules give weapons both positive and negative effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/996fdca2d2b58de8ca4a5544fc7633a4bfa5509e.png[/img]

To explore the desired module, look at the progress tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/4b62102f49189692fe0d06670245c5b4ba6923bb.png[/img]

In the screenshot you can see that at the moment the weapon has 20,000 free XP. 
The free XP is displayed with a blue star:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/2e760a2f60984a1e6378afd4c495f0d02f276f2d.png[/img]

To unlock each module, you will need free XP, as well as a certain number of credits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/bd265fe04db5ec1c15d8cf1bc4b5eff0304e3d0b.png[/img]

Now let's unlock some modules: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/5a2216c81070d454507360005dbbabcb26ac9663.gif[/img]

After unlocking some modules, the free XP was spent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/b912c5863bc4f4cc4753992db5b33c5b127658cd.png[/img]

Now you can attach the new models to the weapon:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/47766811b32d8ed276bd7f0474454fe96f51def1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/da38e7ca986fc445b8677ee00bd0fb811a0c34cf.jpg[/img]

Also now you can connect sights that previously could not be used on some types of weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/d1ef82dbe33f11320d7af8dc60a6a7bfa8e7de4b.jpg[/img]

Experiment with modules to improve your style of play.
Do you like to fight long distance? Reducing the recoil of the weapon will probably suit you. 
Do you want to have an advantage in short fights? Try increasing accuracy from the hip.
The choice is yours!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]NEW MAP[/h1]

Welcome to the arena where fate will be decided in every shot.
In Update 0.7, we present to you our new competitive map - [b]"Cargo"[/b].
Steel walls create a unique gaming environment, providing shelter and opportunities for tactical maneuvers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/fd9da4329cabd437c6dec09ea9fe4a0fa5ff87ee.png[/img]

We have invested many dozens of hours to hone the balance of the sides to perfection. 
At the moment, this is the most balanced map in Polygon and with this we have grandiose plans for the future :)
Immerse yourself in the incredible atmosphere of battles right in the heart of the ocean!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/c07197e8fdd2633cd27f1490271aabf993c9ffff.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]NEW WEAPON[/h1]

Polygon's arsenal has been replenished with new weapons: [b]AK308[/b] and [b]Kriss Vector[/b]. 
Earlier, we have already shown you these weapons in the game. 
You can take a look at it again in the video announcement: 

[previewyoutube=mo78Q5QGnB0;full][/previewyoutube]

To buy Kriss Vector, you will need level 20 of the character, and to buy AK308 - level 24. 
Some weapons have also received a reduction in the required level. You can find out about this in the changes section. 

[hr][/hr]
[h1]WATCH[/h1]

Now you have the opportunity to add a stylish decoration to your character - a [b]wristwatch[/b].
Choose from several models of watches, each of which has its own unique design and features.
From classic to modern style, we have watches to match your taste and preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/8d1cb30ef128ed4e3c137f0fbeafd3ca9c07cfd8.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]NEW BATTLE PASS SEASON[/h1]

The 3rd season of the Battle Pass [b]"Operation: Scarlet Storm"[/b] has started in Polygon. 
The new season has as many as [b]100 reward levels[/b], which is 2 times more than last season.
At the same time, the required progress has been increased by only 40%, which means that you will be able to receive rewards [b]1.5 times more often![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/080ad6399884ac092bb1a42adcecfad0d9a258fe.gif[/img]

[b]Incredibly beautiful skins[/b] were added to the 3rd season.
Some skins now have [b]dynamic material[/b], allowing you to enjoy a truly stunning visual effect. 
See how the skin changes its texture and reflects the environment, creating an effect of depth and liveliness.
Your enemies will envy your aesthetics, and you will enjoy fighting with weapons that stand out among others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/5e3ef9a3740082bcaf7e64959929d64d879bb67c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/75253397a58a75a72fce7b2a9066c4e747ca55be.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/42a9f0b27f831e84ff1b69cb6dbe887fdd2d6ba5.gif[/img]

Also, as a reward, you can get a variety of [b]watches[/b] with a truly unique design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/3a98c21ae0ae2dc768d3beff51c71aa8383a9418.gif[/img]

When you purchase the Battle Pass, you instantly get a [b]"Supreme"[/b] skin for the M16A4, as well as a [b]"Sunfire"[/b] watch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/425c36609c8ccea7b81a864da8f7af313553b101.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/8d1cb30ef128ed4e3c137f0fbeafd3ca9c07cfd8.png[/img]

And at the last levels you will find a [b]golden skin[/b] for Kriss Vector and a [b]Scarlet Storm watch[/b].
The golden skin has a unique new iridescent design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/2bbb423990ecb3c99f9dbeac9199cc9fe366e191.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/96117da9767731d0614b4b1d2712bb852a0d98a2.png[/img]

[u][b]Buy the Battle Pass and get the best rewards! [/b][/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]IMPROVED LIGHTING AND WEATHER[/h1]

One of the main improvements was the new lighting at all game locations. Now you can enjoy amazing gaming moments when every corner of the Polygon world comes to life thanks to improved lighting. Depth and shadows, light and darkness - all this creates an exciting and realistic atmosphere.

[h3]BEFORE \ AFTER[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0f14b7aa638e41b45252be764de4fbd9b0fcfcf3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/dc5dd8793fdb00d107268a0dd2efe34e416404ef.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0373ee6f601239acf806c249ced0f978a6369703.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/af4b98d1b1531fa839fd9152dd74ff74a67781be.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0a217f580708445ebc1932d0cc24f442435afdbe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/d3a67b2f342c103c7746328546101e83ea05247d.jpg[/img]

But that's not all! We have also made changes to the weather to add extra variety and atmosphere to the game. Now you can feel the power of nature when rain washes the area or the sun breaks through the clouds, illuminating your path.
I hope you are not afraid of lightning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/54a9e5b03119c03bca5a45888671a77c248dec84.gif[/img]

The graphics in Polygon have become even more beautiful. You need to see these changes with your own eyes in order to truly appreciate their effect. 

[hr][/hr]
[h1]NEW WEAPON MODULES[/h1]

We have slightly diluted the situation, now we are going back to weapons again, because this is the most important thing for a shooter!
2 new sights have been added to the game: [b]Elcan SpectedDR[/b] and [b]OKP-7[/b].
The Elcan is a medium-range optical sight. 
Do you like having dominance at a distance? Try Elcan! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/fd9fc9359bfc67d9bcd10294535616f382d42555.gif[/img]

Do you want to have real fun on short skirmishes? 
OKP-7 is just created for this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/04aa9ebcfa7e29a5bb82f4209a408b7632695ebf.gif[/img]

Also, the lens shader has been improved for all optical sights and now it has a refraction effect. 
Take a look at this:

[previewyoutube=cz-QvglOzis;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]OTHER CHANGES:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]NEW[/h1]

[list]
[*] The background of the main menu has been redesigned from scratch;
[*] Added a new feature for weapons - [b]"Recoil Control"[/b]. 
This is a multiplier of the sensitivity of the mouse when moving "down" while firing an automatic weapon. The lower the value, the more the sensitivity of the mouse decreases.
Affects only automatic weapons;
[*] Added new weapon skins to the in-game shop;
[*] Added 3 muzzle devices as weapon modules;
[*] Added 3 under-barrel grips as weapon modules;
[*] Added new weapon reloading sounds;
[*] Added new sounds of character steps;
[*] Added new sounds of equipment and holstering weapons;
[*] Added the effect of ejecting the bracket when throwing a grenade;
[*] Now the secondary weapon (pistol) is holstered;
[*] Added the sound of shell casings falling;
[*] Added sound when replenishing ammo from the box;
[*] Added adjustment of the smoothing method (TAA \ MSAA);
[*] Added new music to the main menu;
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]IMPROVED[/h1]

[list]
[*] Ammo boxes and first aid kits now work passively in the field. You don't need to interact with them anymore. It's enough just to stand next to it. 
The time interval for receiving a grenade is 10 seconds;
[*] More boxes of ammunition and first aid kits have appeared on game locations. The previous arrangement of some boxes has been changed;
[*] Improved grenade throwing mechanics. Now you can better control the range of the throw by tilting the character. Also, now the grenade throw is correctly affected by the speed of the character at the time of the grenade throw;
[*] The flashlight for weapons began to shine further and more along the cone, and the quality of shadows from the flashlight has also been improved. 
Also now the flashlight blinds enemies better;
[*] Significantly improved the visibility of characters on dark and light backgrounds;

notes.title: 0.7 Status Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hi there![/h3]
The Polygon Team is back again to tell you the latest news on the 0.7 update.

In the [b]announcement of update 0.7[/b] we shared with you some of the changes we plan on bringing.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1241100/announcements/detail/3386171859242933469
Today we're going to shed some light on those new features and give you some more information about update [b]0.7.[/b]
At the end of this announcement, we will also give a brief status update on our progress thus far.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]| NEW CHARACTER[/b][/h1]

Earlier we showed you the model of the new character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/b9cd64a683a7b254c06e5c88fa547078523379ee.png[/img]

We saw your criticism of the new model, so we've worked on the character a bit more, [b]completely redone[/b] his arms, and [b]improved the overall anatomy[/b].

We will continue to improve the character model as we move forward.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]| WEAPON PROGRESS SYSTEM[/b][/h1]

In the 0.7 announcement we gave you very superficial information about the new weapon progression system. 
Now we're [b]ready to tell you more. [/b]
This will be [b]one of the main features[/b] of update 0.7

The weapon customization menu has been [b]completely changed[/b], you can rotate your weapon and view it from all angles.
It's finally in line with modern shooters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/be7ff92e17ea15c820d6a2f6a88d996284e45488.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/422e3ae613b8f4fc4214e8f38180705bf229610a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/d24adfa83a10957f5d95f5e78bb8e750fe35a6ee.gif[/img]

Yes, yes, you're not imagining it :) These are the [b]new modules![/b]
And they're not for sale in the shop anymore.
But how do you get them you ask? 
Now we come to the most important thing...

Each weapon will have a [b]separate level[/b].
XP gained for the actions in the game, will also increase the XP of the [b]weapon used[/b]. 
Now you won't be able to buy a scope and use it on any gun, you will have to [b]research[/b] this module for each weapon. 
To research the required module, take a look at the [b]progression tree[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/51ca52afbeb92683298e763fd1e4bf4099b85793.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/49c8f0e7bd7244e696f8c805d5468efd19ce32e7.gif[/img]

There are 2 types of XP - [b]total[/b] and [b]unused[/b] XP.
[b]Total XP[/b] is all the XP gained for playing with a specific weapon. 
[b]Unused XP[/b] is the XP that has not been spent on module research.
Thus, you can see all the XP you have gained while using the weapon (total XP), and you will use the unused XP for researching new modules.

In the progression tree, there is a separate branch for each module type. In the future, branches may have branches. This means that if you research one module, you will have several modules available for the next research. 

In future updates we will [b]add new modules[/b] to the progression tree of some weapons. 
We specifically designed this system so that experienced players [b]cannot[/b] instantly get new modules, if a new module is added to a branch level below the explored one. 
Therefore, when adding new modules, [b]everyone[/b] will have to unlock it!

[u][b]Important:[/b][/u] The location of modules in branches, the XP required, and any characteristics are currently informative only and do not demonstrate the end result. 
This is still under development at the moment.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]| NEW MODULES[/b][/h1]

As you may have noticed, [b]muzzle devices[/b] have been added to the game, as well as an [b]underbarrel grip[/b]. 
Now some modules [b]will change the characteristics[/b] of the weapon.
The grips will affect the recoil and accuracy of the weapon, and the muzzle devices will also reduce the muzzle flash (flash hider), change the range and speed of the bullet, and other things. 
In the future, we will be adding more modules that affect weapon characteristics, stay tuned. 

New types of sights have also been added: [b]"OKP-7"[/b] and [b]"Elcan Specter DR"[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/bf86064d71726bf2d5c5e5d229a2cc68efb56d2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/f2c8055d81e624083f1402df626d4d7616efa2a2.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]| NEW MAP[/b][/h1]

Do you like perfect balance?
Do you want some real competition?
The new map will bring a whole [b]new style of gameplay[/b] to POLYGON!

We'v conducted a lot of closed playtests to ensure the gameplay on the new map is [b]as balanced as possible[/b].
At the moment it is considered to be the [b]most balanced map in Polygon[/b]. 
So, we present to you the new map - [u][b]"Cargo"[/b][/u]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/85b67ce9d9617dded36ff06f03c0873300aa1a02.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/25e21c5364360a84f27c4e5d532795a3f30fbd65.gif[/img]

This map was designed specifically for [b]5vs5[/b] competition. 
We will now be able to run tournaments with prize giveaways - [b]officially[/b] from the Polygon Team.
Stay tuned!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]| NEW ANIMATIONS[/b][/h1]

We've changed everything. Completely. From scratch. 
The new character will get brand [b]new animations[/b], which are much better in quality than the old ones. 
We've improved the animations many times already and we'll continue to move in this direction, because [b]high-quality[/b] animations are an absolute necessity in any shooter. 
Without further ado, take a look at the comparison of old and new animations:

And of course now you can finally see your legs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/757fa88684c1407f3658754b85d525f0416d1ec6.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]| NEW GUNS[/b][/h1]

In the 0.7 announcement we showed you one new weapon - [b]AK308[/b]. 
But that's not all that'll be coming. Behold, the [u][b]Kriss Vector[/b][/u]:

notes.title: Global Update Announcement: 0.7
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]
The Polygon Team is back to give more details on the development of POLYGON!

Today we want to tell you about future changes in Polygon. 
You will find an updated character model and animations, an improved progression system for weapons, soldier equipment, new weapons and modules, and, finally, different colors for enemies and allies. 
[b]All this and much more in the future major update 0.7.[/b]

Many thanks to [b]TactiGamer[/b] for his help in announcing this update. You can watch this video to find out some details, as well as get a [b]promo code to get VIP status for 7 days[/b]. 
[previewyoutube=3Da8XatvZCo;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New character[/b][/h1]

In Update 0.7, we will [b]completely update the character model[/b]. Polygon is moving forward and we need to improve the visual quality of the game by adding more details, as well as making the game more unique. 
So, we present to you the new character, Derick:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/b9cd64a683a7b254c06e5c88fa547078523379ee.png[/img]

We tried to keep the style of the game, while making the proportions of the character more realistic, and also add more details. 
We are also preparing for soldier customization, so you can use [b]different skins for solider's clothes[/b]. 
We have also completely redesigned the character's skeleton and are working on remaking most of the animations. 
We hope to compete with AAA games ːsteammockingː 

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Weapon progression system[/b][/h1]

In the current version of the game, to use a module (for example, the red dot sight), you need to get the required level and buy the module in the in-game store with Credits. 
[u]This will change in the 0.7 update. [/u]
Now you have to [b]increase the level of your weapons[/b] to unlock new modules. 
In the next updates, we will add more modules for each weapon, filling out the progression system, and providing more diversity to your playstyle! 
The new progression system will be continuously improved. 

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New equipment[/b][/h1]

In a future update, players will have more control over their preferred playstyle. 
Do you want to become super fast and take new positions on the battlefield with lightning speed? 
Or do you want to be like iron man, absorbing an incredible amount of damage? 
New equipment for your character will [b]give you the choice[/b]. 

Now you can equip different levels of armor on your soldier. 
You'll be able to combine it in any way: a helmet and a heavy bulletproof vest or a light unloading vest? The choice is yours.

FAQ: What the future holds for Polygon.
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Friends [/h2]

You constantly ask us about future changes in Polygon, offer your ideas and give constructive criticism. [b]Thank you[/b], this is very valuable information for us. [b]We see everything. [/b]

Today we want to tell you about our plans for the future, as well as answer some questions that many players are interested in regarding the current version of the game.
[b]We will be absolutely honest with you. [/b]

[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]When will new weapons be added to the game?[/b]
[h4]• Answer: [/h4]
This is a very popular question and we would like to answer the question in as much detail as possible:
Adding new weapons is not an easy task; to do this, we need to create a model of the weapon, find suitable sounds, adjust all the stats and check the balance of the weapon. Among other things, one of the important parts of the gunplay is high-quality and smooth animations for weapons. And just at this point we have a problem. 
For a long time we have been wanting to change the model of our current character (for those who don't know, his name is Derick), but unfortunately there are even more difficulties in this. For this reason, it currently makes no sense to add new weapons to the game and make animations for the current model, then do it all again when the new character is ready. 
As soon as the new character model is ready, we will add a huge variety of new weapons with high-quality animations. At the moment, we do not have a timeline for when this will happen, but I can say for sure that, unfortunately, we will need at least a few more months for this. During this time, we can add new weapons that will use animations of weapons that are currently in the game due to the similarity of the design (for example, AK-47 -> AK-74M -> AK12). But we will be able to add radically different types of weapons like the Bullpup system and others only from the moment the new character is ready.  If you have the skills to create high quality 3D characters and you want to help us with this, please write to us. This will significantly speed up the process.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]When will new weapon modules be added to the game? When will a weapon silencer be added?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
As we have already answered above, we are waiting for the new character model to be ready. This is not a quick process. For the same reason, we currently can't add some types of modules to the game, such as weapon handles, which also require new animations. We will continue to add sights and other modules that do not require animations. 

[b]Regarding the silencer for weapons:[/b] yes, this does not require animations. But that requires sounds. Below we will give a detailed explanation to the current sound system in Polygon.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]When will new maps be added to the game? [/b]
[h4]• Answer: [/h4]
At the moment we are working on the current maps, namely improving lighting, optimization, balancing, bug fixing, etc. We have a definite action plan for this task. We plan to finish all the work on current maps soon, and prepare a new map by the end of 2022. If you have skills working with level design and you want to help us, please write to us. This will significantly speed up the process.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]Will vehicles be added to the game: cars, tanks, planes, helicopters, etc.?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
We have no plans for adding vehicles to the game in the near future, because there is simply no need for it. All current maps were developed for infantry fighting. Initially, we had plans to add equipment, but we changed the direction of development and put maximum emphasis on infantry fighting. If we had added vehicles, the gameplay would have been much worse than it is now, because we would have had less time to develop and improve the current combat systems. But for the distant future we have thoughts about it. Perhaps this will happen when the game is ready for this (large maps, a variety of content, high-quality gameplay, and more). But it definitely won't happen this year or early next year. 
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]What are you planning to do with the levelling? At the moment, this is quite a long process and it is difficult for players to get levels to buy weapons and modules.[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
We wouldn't want the players to get all the weapons in a couple of hours of play. This is a premeditated move. Polygon is not a game in which you have the opportunity to get any weapon at the start. We also want to allow high-level players to feel their progress in the game. We also tried very hard to make sure that every weapon in the game has the same chance of winning. Of course it depends on the situation, it will be difficult for you to win at close range against the G36C with the M24 in your hands. Of course we plan to add more weapons for the initial levels in the future. 
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]Do you plan to add character classes like Medic, Assault, etc.?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
At the moment we have plans to improve the importance of characters in battle. We have not yet figured out definitively how this will happen - with the help of classes or a different system, but it will definitely happen in the future.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]When will the skins for the character be added?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
We have plans to do this in the near future.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]When will the teams have different camouflage? [/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
When the new character model is finished, your enemies will no longer have the exact same textures as your allies. But this doesn't mean they will be completely different. In the future we will add character skins and customization, because of this, it will be possible for your enemy to have similar colors on their uniform. This is why we are making the systems that will help distinguish enemy from friendly, like the markers above allied players, and the red glow around enemies.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]Will armor and other equipment be added for the character? [/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
We have plans for this for the future, but we can't give you more information about it yet. This answer will be updated in the future when we are ready to share with you about it.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]When will the new Battle Pass season start?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
At the moment we are focused as much as possible on improving the gameplay: gunplay, animations, graphics and more. Most likely, the new season will not begin until mid-autumn. We will definitely notify everyone in advance about this and start the timer in the game before the end of the current season. You will have enough time to complete the season.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]Will player stats be added?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
We plan to add simplified statistics such as player progress, number of kills, favorite weapons and more. But we cannot provide information about when this will come. In any case, this is not a priority task at the moment.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]Will parkour be added to the game? [/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
We have plans to add a simplified model of parkour and vertical play, such as vaulting, using ladders and more. But it won't be like Assassin's Creed 🙂 
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]When will the sounds in the game be improved?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
At the moment we are starting the process of improving and refining the sounds in the game. We may have to change the game's sound engine, which may affect some of the current sounds in the game. It is for this reason that we currently try [u][b]not[/b][/u] to add/improve sounds. This is one of the priorities for the near future.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]Will a smoke grenade be added?[/b]
[h4]• Answer: [/h4]
Yes, we are planning to add a smoke grenade to the game.
[hr][/hr]
[h4]| Question:   [/h4]
[b]The developer is developing the game alone. Will new developers be invited to develop the game? What should I do if I want to help develop Polygon?[/b]
[h4]• Answer:[/h4]
We are constantly looking for talented people who can help us develop the game. Unfortunately, we don't have the resources to support a large number of developers. Already now we are trying to work with some freelancers to speed up the game development process. For example, all new models of weapons were made for us by a talented 3D artist. 
Our [url=https://www.patreon.com/redaster_polygon]Patrons[/url] help us a lot in financing the development, for which we thank them very much. If you feel that you can help us with the development of the game, please write to us here on Discord or send an Email. We welcome any help. 
[hr][/hr]
We hope that this information will provide answers to your questions. If you have any additional questions, you can ask us in the topic of this post. We will give a detailed answer to the most interesting questions in the FAQ text. 

In our [url=https://discord.gg/Ywu74qDFXe]Discord[/url], you can discuss this FAQ with the Polygon team and other players.

[b]-Polygon Team [/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 0.6: Ballistics, Loadout System, New Modules
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

Not so long ago we published the news about the beginning of the public playtest for everyone. 
Together, we discovered a big number of bugs in the gameplay, which were fixed.
[b]Special thanks[/b] to everyone who took part in the playtest, you have helped us a lot!
As a reward, each participant of the playtest could receive VIP status for 7 days.

Today we officially announce the update fully ready to be released on the main server.
We have been working on this update for a very long time and we hope you all will enjoy it :)

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
This update includes hundreds of improvements, changes and bug fixes. Here are some of the highlights you can expect in this update:
[list]
[*] Ballistics system that includes the drop of bullets depending on the type of caliber, as well as the ability to penetrate and ricochet off of objects;
[*] In-game loadout system that allows you to change and customize weapons during the match without going to the main menu;
[*] Improved Lighting and Optimization on Valley;
[*] 2 brand new sights and a flashlight. All other models of weapon modules have received a complete redesign;
[*] Complete redesign of all weapon models; 
[*] New character levels. Now the maximum level is 50;
[*] Notification system for game events;
[/list]
You can see the full list of all changes below.

[h2]BALLISTICS[/h2]

So, as mentioned above, ballistics will add bullet drop depending on the caliber of the weapon. 
Thus, sniper rifles will be able to shoot at a longer distance than pistols. 
We tried to calibrate the physics of the bullets falling so that it didn't change the gameplay too much, compared to the old version, where there was no ballistics at all. 
Therefore, it is possible that at a short shooting distance you will not notice any changes. This was done on purpose. We are still continuing to calibrate physics and we hope to improve this in the future. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0d40ea317980db717f589e102d341aebbb9d6916.jpg[/img]

Also, the new ballistics system includes the possibility to penetrate some objects. This depends on the material from which the object is made, as well as the thickness of the object itself. Thus, the probability of breaking through a wooden pallet is much higher than a thick sheet of metal or a brick wall. 
It also depends on the caliber of the weapon. 
After breaking through the object, the bullet loses some of its energy, which also depends on the physical data described above.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/9d2f03d3e039e26e731fa2bdcd4737f3ae1996b1.jpg[/img]

But that's not all. The new ballistics system adds the ability to ricochet bullets. This also depends on the material and caliber of the weapon. So, bullets will ricochet from metal surfaces, but not from sand. 
After ricocheting against the surface, the bullet will lose some of its energy. This depends on many indicators, such as the angle of the ricochet, the speed of the bullet and others.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/1149006f138574dc9adc1ba78a0c13484786a4f1.jpg[/img]

[u]You can try ballistics now![/u]

[h2]LOADOUT SYSTEM[/h2]

Previously, all players had to leave the server to change and customize weapons in the main menu. Now you can do it during the game without leaving and without losing progress! Just choose a new weapon and customize it to your liking right in the game.

So, there are 2 loadout modes: [b]compact[/b] and [b]full[/b]. 
[b]Compact[/b] allows you to quickly select other available weapons in your inventory. Previously installed modules will be automatically installed on the selected weapon. 
Just choose G36C instead of M24 and repel the enemy's attack on the objective. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/f552679b56373dbbff783153093e7e261d1e39df.png[/img]

[b]Full[/b] mode allows you to compare the characteristics of weapons, as well as install modules that are available in your inventory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/f398c59fab252454ac97aff4115006bc23010169.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/e401d6a4009b1b7cf7f0127b146072270456d694.jpg[/img]
This is only the first stage of the new function. This system will be improved in the future. 

[h2]NEW LIGHTING[/h2]

Polygon is a beautiful game, isn't it? :) But it can be even more beautiful.
Lighting plays an extremely important role in graphic visualization. This allows you to dive deeper into the gameplay, feel the atmosphere and depth of the space better.
Therefore, it is always necessary to start with stage lighting. 

Polygon will now use a different lighting algorithm. This will significantly improve the quality of graphics. 
Unfortunately, setting up a new algorithm takes quite a long time, so we decided to start updating the lighting gradually. And we will start with the [b]"Valley"[/b] map.
We will show you some screenshots to compare the old and new lighting.
[h3]BEFORE \ AFTER[/h3]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/48c2a36196bcd81f196d06b9ab8b50413b80cdbc.jpg[/img]

You can see that the lighting has become more balanced. Unnaturally dark areas have become lighter, and its now darker indoors. 
The new lighting algorithm will also [b]increase FPS[/b] in some cases by up to [b]50%[/b].
We have put a lot of work into working out the new lighting, but there may still be some lighting errors in some places. We will continue to work on this.

But that's not all! Previously, if you used low graphics settings, your shadows completely disappeared. Now shadows will be visible even at the [b]lowest graphics[/b] settings and this will [b]not affect FPS[/b] in any way!
[h3]BEFORE\AFTER[/h3] (low graphics settings)

In the future, all other maps will also have improved lighting. At the moment, this is only available for [b]Valley[/b].

[h2]UPDATED MODELS[/h2]

In the last major update, we started improving some weapon models and we continued to update them in 0.6. 
Fully updated models of weapon modules:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/32cad94ab028fa37abf283f01820beac71651859.png[/img]

We also added 2 brand new sights: [b]"Cobra"[/b] and [b]"Pistol Collimator"[/b]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0fe9966e60361573b1b280484d4ff910c3b74ac6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/4e5c1840b2d42b1d5e589903ff020199dbb3efab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/d8b8a319432110e18ac9229559c762af67558e64.png[/img]

In addition, a completely new module for weapons has been added - the [u][b]flashlight[/b][/u]. 
This will make it possible to illuminate some dark areas in the game world, and also allow you to blind the enemy at close range. 
Remember that this also makes you easier to spot, use it wisely!
You can purchase a flashlight in the in-game store for credits - the currency earned by playing the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/4376a406a7e4694906571e7b44b1a57815e9aba7.png[/img]

We have also updated the models of all the weapons that are in the game at the moment.
All current weapon skins have also been completely redesigned. No new skins were added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/d32b187a340c7b7c6ba7035de9edf30ecaaf14bd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/133345d461e74f775bafbbb8a8db4e33cfd55226.png[/img]

[h2]NEW LEVELS[/h2]

Before this update, you could reach a maximum level of 40. Now the maximum level in the game is 50. It takes 4,138,000 experience to get level 50. 

We have also updated the icons of all levels in the game. Now it has a more attractive look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/da9d503f164aadc0e47d8043c725a82edc97ce51.png[/img]

The following information applies only to players who previously had level 40: 
Unfortunately, we had to reset the experience to the level required to get level 40. So, if you had, for example, 5,000,000 experience, then your experience will be reset to the level required to get level 40 (1,898,000). 
In general, this will not affect your game in any way, but we understand that this is upsetting news for some players. So, we have prepared an exclusive item for you: a watch that displays the total number of all kills, starting from the moment of using this watch. 
Also, a number is displayed depending on what place you had on the experience leaderboard before this update. No one else will be able to get this watch, it is completely exclusive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/dfa1294fa51c67eae42f53081c30937210f9e429.png[/img]
We will start issuing this item after the update starts. It will take us some time to do this.

A notification system for game events has been added to the game. At the moment, you receive notifications about the beginning of the capture of an objective by your team or the enemy team. In the future, other notifications will be added to help you react to various events quickly.

notes.title: The Future in Polygon: Ballistics
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, Friends! [/h3]
Today we will tell you about the [u][b]new game mechanics[/b][/u] that will soon appear in the game.

At the moment, all weapons in the game use traces as bullets.
Not so long ago, we added a damage multiplier depending on the distance, which is calculated using the simple formula based on the distance to the enemy. But this does not allow you to fully immerse yourself in the gameplay. [u][b]We want more realism! [/b][/u]
That's why we started developing an advanced bullet system that uses the world's physical constants. 

The new bullet technology will have [b]ballistic indicators[/b]. Now you will have to do a pre-emption to hit the target at a long distance. 
Of course, each caliber has unique aerodynamic data. [b]And we did it![/b] So, each bullet has its own mass, form factor, initial energy, diameter and other indicators that will affect the entire system. 

In addition, new bullets can [b]ricochet[/b] off some objects. [b]And it's not just graphics![/b] This is a real bullet, which will also cause damage if it hits the target after a ricochet. Now you don't have to see the enemy to kill him :) 
Of course, we also took into account all the physical data and the probability and angle of the ricochet, and the residual energy varies depending on the material of the object, as well as the physical data of the bullet itself. So, if you hit the metal, there will be the highest probability of a ricochet, while if you hit the sand, there can be no ricochet. 
This also takes into account the angle of the shot.

But that's not all.
So, new bullets [b]can shoot through some objects[/b], after which the bullet can also cause damage to the enemy. 
[b]And it also takes into account all physical indicators![/b] So, a bullet with more mass and energy is able to penetrate thicker objects than a weaker bullet. 
After departure, the bullet loses some of its energy.
And it also depends on the material of the object. For example, you can easily break through a wooden door, but it's not a fact that you will be able to do it with a metal door. 

We really hope that the new game mechanics will bring more interest and realism to the gameplay. This should also simplify the game for beginners, and experienced players will be able to get more pleasure from hitting the target at a long distance. In the future, we will prepare for you a system of [b]rewards and achievements[/b] that you will receive when killing opponents at a long distance. All players will be able to see what a cool sniper you are :)

The Biggest Update is 0.5: Squads, Metro, new weapon models, etc.
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

Today, POLYGON launched the [b]Largest Update In History[/b], which will bring a lot of new things to the game.
Everyone has been waiting for these changes for a long time. And finally we can show you what we have been working hard on lately.

[b]Special thanks[/b] to all the testers who took part in the [b]public playtest[/b] and helped to identify the most critical bugs that were fixed before the release.
For this, they were rewarded with a new cosmetic item - [b]"Weapon Strap"[/b] for Scar-H.

So, let's start:

[h2]---------- NEW----------[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a [u][b]Squad system[/b][/u] that allows you to assemble a group of up to 5 players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/ac7e23f7c32d9431d14a9e4b3307517d1cbc2464.jpg[/img]
To add a player to the Squad, simply add him as a friend on Steam, and then use the Squad invitation interface in the main menu of the game.
Any member of the Squad can invite players to the Squad. It is not necessary to be the leader for this.
The leader can transfer his leadership to another member of the Squad, as well as kick other players. If the leader leaves the Squad, another squad member will take his place.
Also, only the Squad leader can create and connect to servers. The rest of the Squad will follow along with him automatically. There is no need to confirm readiness.

On the battlefield, you can choose your squadmates [b]as your points of deployment[/b].
At the same time, you will be able to observe your friend through a [b]special camera[/b], which will allow you to better understand the situation around the character in order to react faster to events at the time of deployment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/48e8038609b860677682090c152b6e4b38551436.jpg[/img]
When deployed next to a Squad member, you lose 2 magazines to the main weapon, as well as 1 grenade. This will make the balance of the game better.
There are also some restrictions for deployment, if the player is any of these, no one can spawn on him: if the player has entered combat, is next to an enemy, or in the air.
Perhaps in the future the restrictions will be changed.

Each member of the Squad is marked in green, which allows you to identify your friends faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/ddefc9a46f442567e0349a8788c23d12038b0d0c.png[/img]

You will also see the health of each Squad member next to the minimap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/141472f98be264abc39eeb330473653716685000.png[/img]

If you leave the game, you will automatically leave the Squad. This mechanic will be improved in the future.

[u][b]Call your friends and play shoulder to shoulder![/b][/u]

[*] New map: [u][b]"Metro"[/b][/u].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/8c5f7cfda00ea618a8f5413ae2fb43d63fb005e3.png[/img]
This location may seem familiar to you and this is exactly what you are thinking 😉
This is the first map in POLYGON with a completely enclosed space.
At the moment, there can be up to 24 players in the Metro. Perhaps this will be changed in the future.

Also, together with Metro, we have added a new game mode - [u][b]"King of the Hill"[/b][/u]: a mode with one control point on the map, on which it is impossible [b](!)[/b] to deploy. 
The capture of the control point is 3 times faster than in the "Conquest" mode.
The team that scored the most points by the end of the game or scored the maximum number of points wins.

Metro is currently in testing mode.
In the future, the visuals, optimization, and balance will be improved on the Metro map.

[*] Added a new feature: [u][b]KillCam[/b][/u]. After death, KillCam will help you look at your killer, as well as provide some information: nickname, rank, health and weapons of the enemy,
as well as display information about the K/D ratio in relation to the you. This feature will be improved in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/8a1f595987bac70aa1f282b8eabd6da46482ac3d.jpg[/img]

[*] POLYGON servers have switched to a [b]new network model[/b], which should improve the stability of the game and reduce latency.

[*] Some models of weapons have received a [b]complete redesign[/b]. All current skins for these weapon models have also received a complete redesign.
No new skins were added.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/8768a2c8748e098716d27ab0881efccda70ec6f8.png[/img]

[*] A [u][b]watch[/b][/u] has been added to the game.
The first watch model is available to all players [b]absolutely free[/b] of charge. The hands of the watch always show your real time.
In the future, more watch models will be added, with which you can improve the appearance of your character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/cacbd35f490874f882c23243c19806b5e8a7e6d8.png[/img]

[*] Some types of weapons have received a new appearance function - a [u][b]Weapon Strap[/b][/u].
You can buy Weapon Strap in the game store.
Some Weapon Straps are available [b]for in-game currency[/b].
This is an experimental innovation. We hope you enjoy this feature.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/be0bd19b901536e2ade165d1024f31ce3f792a3f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/eba7bd26279af75c53a578db8d9356a7a63ca046.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/9e31a1dff6572c1ab75ab9642b36071d38e7feab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/2e72d1e7b4b09a64fe0f79e02baaa41156a3ed9f.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/a8fc7d18359e7d56bbef4448ed60722907f73ca8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/4edab1fd15b209cd48bd7959e0084ad833bca9ac.png[/img][/url]

[*] Added the function that allows you to [b]report a player[/b]. At the moment, you can report for obscene behavior and the use of cheats.

[*] Now, before connecting to the server, you automatically [b]reserve a slot[/b] on the server, which guarantees you a place on the server at the time of connection.
This will fix the problem where you were kicked from the game if someone logged on to the server faster than you during the loading.

[*] Added a countdown before the end of the session.

[*] Now, when viewing the results of the match (end of match), you can open the scoreboard.

[*] Now, at the moment of choosing the point of dislocation, the closest point to the place of death of the character is automatically selected.
[/list]

[h2]---------- CHANGED----------[/h2]

[list]
[*] Now, after the end of the game, the server will be automatically restarted, instead of forcibly disconnecting from the session.
In this case, the sides will change and you will be able to continue playing with the current players.
If necessary, you can still leave the game on your own after the end of the session.
In the future, it will be possible to vote for the next map.

[*] Earlier, if the last player from the enemy team leaves the game, the game will automatically count the victory in favor of your team.
This mechanic has been changed and now the game is paused until the required number of players is gathered to continue the game.

[*] The visuals of [b]each map[/b] has been improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/6cac622dee11dce7c933fc626431bc627870ba39.png[/img]

[*] Image sharpness has been improved.

[*] The HUD in the game has received some redesign.

[*] Character size has been increased by 15%.

[*] Improved translation into Chinese.

[*] The recoil mechanics of the weapon has been improved.

[*] The maximum possible FOV is now 125 degrees.

[*] The collimator's FOV was changed from 70 to 85.

[*] The FOV of the holographic sight was changed from 60 to 80.

[*] The FOV of the standard sight was changed from 70 to 85.

[*] Improved some character animations.

[*] Aiming animation has become smoother.

[*] Improved character lean system.

[*] Now all the sights in the game are perfectly calibrated.

[*] Chromatic aberration has been disabled.

[*] Improved weapon physics at the moment of character's death.

[*] The size of all buses has been increased.
[/list]

[h2]---------- FIXED ----------[/h2]

[list]
[*] The character's hands are distorted when the FOV indicator changes.

[*] Displaying the recoil of weapons in the game store.

[*] Incorrect character lean.

[*] Sometimes it is impossible to shoot after changing weapons.

[*] It is impossible to make a jump using the scroll wheel.

[*] Kick from the server immediately after connection.

[*] Infinite connection to the server.

[*] Collisions of some objects.

[*] Some other bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcement: Squads
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

We continue to tell you about the future global update in Polygon.
And today we will talk about the long-awaited [b][u]Squad System[/u][/b].

We have been receiving messages from you for a long time with requests to add the opportunity to play in a group with friends.
Unfortunately, this feature is quite difficult to create at a high quality, so it took us a long time to implement it in the game.

[b]But soon everything will change![/b] Start calling your friends now, because the [u][b]"Squads"[/b][/u] feature will finally appear in the next update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/ac7e23f7c32d9431d14a9e4b3307517d1cbc2464.jpg[/img]

A Squad can have up to [u][b]5 players[/b][/u]. To invite a player to the Squad, just [b]add them as a friend on Steam[/b], the invite them through the new Squad Menu. Your friend will receive an invitation [b]in game[/b], and once accepted, you will be able to join the same server together.

In the game, each member of the Squad will be [b]marked in green[/b], which will distinguish your friends from other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/ddefc9a46f442567e0349a8788c23d12038b0d0c.png[/img]

Also, you can [b]monitor the health[/b] of your teammates with the help of indicators located next to the minimap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/141472f98be264abc39eeb330473653716685000.png[/img]

Of course, in order to get the [b]maximum enjoyment[/b] from playing in a group, you need to constantly be [u][b]shoulder to shoulder.[/b][/u] And for this you can [b]respawn next to any of your Squad members[/b] [*there are small conditions].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/48e8038609b860677682090c152b6e4b38551436.jpg[/img]

You can also see exactly [b]what your Squad members are doing[/b] while waiting to respawn, all you have to do is click on them. Initially, this window is in a smaller size but it can be enlarged (as in the screenshot).

We remind you that the Squad system is [b]still under development[/b] and these screenshots are not the final stage of development. It is possible that some elements of the user interface will be changed before or after the release of the update.

For today, this is all the information about Squads that we can share with you.
[u][b]Don't forget to tell your friends about it![/b][/u]

notes.title: Major Update: 0.4.14.77
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone.[/h3]

Today we will tell you about the new POLYGON update, which is already available for all players.
A new [b]Anti-Cheat[/b], [b]Vote Kick[/b] system, [b]new weapon[/b] and much more..

[h2]ANTI-CHEAT[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/550f9aef0437d69c6e94e2ed5d9ca2b6a8f68a0b.jpg[/img]
It's no secret that cheaters have flooded POLYGON. We are all tired of cheaters. It's time to end this.
In the current update, we have integrated a [b]new Anti-Cheat[/b] that will fight for the integrity of the game. 
From now on, we will meet with cheaters much less often.
But if you meet with a cheater, now we have something else for them: [b]forced exclusion from the game[/b]. 
After being excluded from the game, the player will no longer be able to connect to the current server. 
We hope that these innovations will make the game more honest. 

[h2]New Weapon - M24[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/6f70feb511e0958b80eb3c92a7747e2e05bad7bb.png[/img]
Many players are waiting for new guns. In particular, many people dream of new sniper rifles.
We want to please you.
Now a new sniper rifle is available for purchase - [b]M24.[/b]
M24 has the [b]largest one-time damage and shooting distance[/b] of all weapons in the game at the moment. Hitting the enemy's head immediately puts him out of action. 
A [b]new 8X optical sight[/b] is also available for the M24.
The M24 is available for purchase starting from the [b]10th level[/b] of the soldier's development.

[h2]BATTLE PASS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/a6bb1fcecbed288377fd4d23d9bf82b89a316991.png[/img]
A [b]Battle Pass[/b] has appeared in POLYGON, which consists of 30 levels. 
Unlock Battle Pass levels for any XP gained in battle.
Use the VIP status and [b]get 40% more XP[/b] towards the Battle pass.
For opening levels, you will receive rewards: [b]VIP status days[/b], [b]Credits and Crowns[/b],  [b]soldier XP[/b], as well as [b]unique skins for weapons[/b] that cannot be purchased in the store for three months after the end of the Battle Pass season.
You can also purchase a [b]Premium Battle Pass[/b] and receive [b]additional rewards[/b] for each level.
You can purchase a Premium Battle Pass at any time of the event. You will immediately receive all the rewards up to the current level.
Battle Pass XP can be purchased separately to unlock new levels faster.
[b]Don't miss the chance to be the first to get unique rewards![/b]

[h2]Premium Features[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/4526cb98c07b41571837dab2dc13396358591a46.png[/img]
Now VIP status increases the XP gained per game by [b]100%[/b], and credits by [b]75%[/b]. Previously, the VIP status increased the XP and credits received by 50%.
VIP status now also increases the XP of "Battle Pass" by [b]40%[/b].

[u]Prices for all weapon skins have been significantly reduced.[/u]

[h2]Game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/35398a5cfb99381d80bb3155b6b8340a1267355b.jpg[/img]
The image quality in the game has become [b]much clearer[/b];
Improved fog on all maps: now it has a gradient depending on the distance from the player;
Accelerated FOV when aiming;
The recoil of all pistols was significantly reduced;
The recoil of the VSS and M14 was reduced;
Added [b]new lens flares[/b];
Fixed FPS drop during shooting;
Fixed the position of the M14 holographic sight;

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/15986af6f5ee69ab01f2f88be9e81e033e43bfa7.jpg[/img]
The user interface in the main menu of the game has been [b]significantly improved[/b]. 
Almost all elements of the user interface have been redesigned.
Added a [b]new atmospheric soundtrack[/b] in the main menu.

[h3]We really hope that you will enjoy this update. We are trying to make POLYGON better.[/h3]

Global Update: 0.3.11.67 - New Animations
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]

We recently showed you a video presentation of the new animation system In our game. 
[previewyoutube=JCSdrHdVNII;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]ANIMATIONS[/h3]

After hard work and testing, we are letting all players have access to the new animations.
The update affects absolutely all character animations and weapons, significantly improving the gameplay.

We have also added two types of reloads: full and tactical. 
These reloads will change the way your player reloads depending on the remaining ammunition left in your weapon. 
The weapon change animation has been significantly accelerated, which will finally add meaning to the use of secondary weapons.

The crouching in the game has been overhauled also you now make less noise while moving while crouched!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/0e374ed5e12db9462db217513d2786e4d07e97a5.png[/img]

[h3]CHARACTER[/h3]

The character that was present in Polygon did not look anything like a War machine. Not anymore.
Meet the War Machine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/c6a99bdc5f16a0973edde78cb6afb52c0a0848d2.png[/img]

We have significantly improved the appearance of the characters, adding more details, and also improved the hands.

Now the characters of both teams look the same, except for the colored identification armbands. In the future, players will be able to customize the appearance of their character to make it unique. We are already preparing an update for this.

[h3]COLLISIONS[/h3]

Many players complained about the incorrect location of object collisions, which interfered with shooting and movement around the map. We fixed it.
Collisions on all maps have been manually reworked and optimized, which will not only allow for more accurate shooting, but also improve the performance of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/b6ea02b25bdfe40a09f96f6a9eaaee44bc2d1170.png[/img]

[h2]List of all changes
[/h2]
[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated all character and weapon animations;
[*] All weapons now have 2 reload types: Full and Tactical;
[*] The character has been completely redesigned;
[/list]

[h3]Changed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved and optimized weapon recoil;
[*] Adjusted the position of the sight for all weapons;
[*] Improved models of some weapons;
[*] Improved character ragdoll;
[*] The weapon change animation has been significantly accelerated;
[/list]

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed collisions for all objects;
[*] Fixed ammo and health replenishment via crates;
[*] Fixed sensitivity during aiming with certain scopes;
[*] The character now transitions normally to a crouching state.;
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new update.
If you find any bugs make sure to report them in the discord, we will do our best to fix these by the next update! 
Also join our [url=https://discord.gg/cmPdkvu]Discord[/url]: [url=https://discord.gg/cmPdkvu]https://discord.gg/cmPdkvu[/url]

Update 0.2.8.59: We Are Back
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Friends![/h1]

Development of the game was suspended for a [b]long time[/b]. There were good reasons for this.
The players were waiting for the continuation of the development of Polygon, in every possible way supported us - the developers.
[b]We are grateful to everyone, it really motivates us to move on![/b]

We have prepared a small update that fixes some old problems.
This is just preparation for further development.

[h1]Graphics:[/h1]

In the new update, the graphical part of the game has been [b]significantly improved[/b].
Improved lighting on all maps. The entire environment now reflects more realistically, and there is now more lighting in the shadows, which will allow you to see many of the details previously hidden in the darkness.

[h1]Animations:[/h1]

A lot of people, including us - the developers, were not satisfied with the animation of the character. The character seemed too slow and awkward due to the animations not working properly.
We decided to fix this and significantly improved all character animations.
Now everything happens more smoothly, which will significantly improve the interaction with weapons, shooting, and, accordingly, the attitude to the game.
Of course, what we have now is not the final version. We are still very far from ideal, but we will strive for this.

Before \ After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/34b05f611af6536940061178a83efac4cd777eb6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36822996/c9d9f4990e97e92922e84b38929d6a4c18b219da.gif[/img]

[h1]Optimization:[/h1]

[b](Experimental)[/b] We changed the method of rendering graphics to a cheaper one, which will increase the FPS in some cases [b]up to 50%.[/b]
Of course, we are aware of many other optimization problems. We will try to fix this as soon as possible. This task is of higher priority.

[h1]Game process:[/h1]

All of the above changes will significantly improve the overall gameplay. But we also made some other changes.

Sprint has become [b]~40% faster[/b], which will make the game more dynamic.
The character's tilts up / down became [b]much faster.[/b]
Tilting the character to the left / right now allows you to [b]better look behind obstacles.[/b]

[b]Unfortunately, it was not without problems.[/b]
Due to the transition of the game to a new version of the engine, we lost the WWII map. This may be a temporary problem, we will try to fix it shortly, but at the moment it is impossible to play on this map.

[h3]We hope that all these changes will allow you to look at the game from a different perspective and, possibly, reconsider your opinion. After all, the future of Polygon depends only on you![/h3]
